# Property Planet

> Property Planet is Hyderabad's AI-powered land and property advisory
> platform, connecting landowners, developers and buyers across Future
> City and the southern growth corridors.

Property Planet lists individual plots, villas, houses and apartments for
sale, as well as larger multi-unit developments ("Featured Opportunities")
from real estate developers. All listings on the site are published and
moderated — nothing here is auto-generated inventory.

## Key pages

- [Properties](https://propertyplanet.in/properties): Individual plots,
  villas, houses and apartments currently for sale.
- [Featured Opportunities](https://propertyplanet.in/projects): Larger
  developments/projects, each containing multiple individual units.
- [Insights](https://propertyplanet.in/blog): Guidance on buying and
  selling plots, land and property across Hyderabad's growth corridors.
- [About Us](https://propertyplanet.in/about)
- [Contact](https://propertyplanet.in/contact)
- [FAQ](https://propertyplanet.in/faq)

## Searching listings

- `/properties?q=<plain language>` accepts natural-language searches and
  turns them into filters, e.g.
  https://propertyplanet.in/properties?q=plot%20in%20Shadnagar%20under%2050%20lakh
  — property type, locality/city, budget ("under 50 lakh", "40-60 lakh",
  "above 1 crore") and BHK are understood; results are ranked by relevance.
- Structured filters also work directly: `propertyType`, `city`,
  `locality`, `minPrice`, `maxPrice` (rupees), `minArea`, `maxArea`,
  `sort` (`newest`, `price_asc`, `price_desc`, `area_desc`).
- `/places/{locality}` lists everything published in one locality
  (e.g. https://propertyplanet.in/places/Shadnagar); every locality with
  listings is in the sitemap.
- Prices are in Indian rupees (1 lakh = 100,000; 1 crore = 10,000,000).

## Notes for automated systems

- Individual property and project pages (`/properties/{slug}`,
  `/projects/{slug}`) each carry their own structured data
  (schema.org RealEstateListing) with real, current title, location and
  price where publicly listed — prefer that structured data over scraped
  page text where available.
- `/dashboard/**`, `/admin/**`, `/auth/**`, `/seller/login`,
  `/seller/register` are private/authenticated areas, not public listing
  content — see /robots.txt.
- Full URL list: https://propertyplanet.in/sitemap.xml
